nodes.description: Address of the contract owner, receives Ether from expandX, expandY, buySpecialBuilding and a 3% cut from buyItem.
Address of the current king (highest spirit), set in newLeader and paid in buyItem.
Spirit score of the current king, updated by newLeader.
Address of the current queen (highest prestige), set in newLeader and paid in buyItem.
Prestige score of the current queen, updated by newLeader.
Counter of initiated kingdoms, incremented in initiateUser.
Number of registered building templates, incremented in initBuilding.
Monotonic marketplace listing id, incremented in sellItem.
Nested mapping seller=>item=>price used by sellItem and buyItem.
Nested mapping seller=>item=>listing id used by sellItem and buyItem.
Mapping address=>City holding resources, map, resourceFactors and timers for each player.
Mapping index=>Building template list written by initBuilding.
Constructor initializing owner, king, queen and counters from msg.sender.
Owner-only registration of building templates into the buildings mapping.
Emits the Resources event with the caller's current resource balances.
Promotes the caller to king/queen when its spirit or prestige exceeds the stored value.
First-time initialization of a player's city with starting resources and map size.
Places a building on the caller's map, adjusts resourceFactors and deducts resource prices.
Payable map expansion along X; forwards msg.value to owner.
Payable map expansion along Y; forwards msg.value to owner.
Time-gated harvesting of basic resources based on resourceFactors.
Time-gated special item claim using a timestamp-derived pseudo-random selector.
Lists a resource item on the internal marketplace with a price.
Payable purchase of a listed item; splits msg.value between owner, king, queen and seller.
Payable placement of premium buildings 97-99 granting spirit/prestige bonuses.
Caller-controlled address used as kingdom key, owner check and payout recipient.
now/block.timestamp is used for claim cooldowns and pseudo-random item selection.
owner.transfer(msg.value) in expandX forces Ether to the owner address.
owner.transfer(msg.value) in expandY forces Ether to the owner address.
owner.transfer(msg.value) in buySpecialBuilding forwards the full payment.
Unchecked subtraction of building prices from kingdoms[msg.sender].resources and += on populationNeeded.
Weak randomness: select = (now-(item+shopIndex))%13 derives item rewards from block.timestamp.
msg.value/100 based cut transfers to owner, king, queen and seller with multiple external calls.
Access control via require(msg.sender == owner) guarding building template registration.
Unchecked += of resourceFactors into the caller's resource balances.
Payment tiers enforced by require on msg.value for buildings 97/98/99 combined with map coordinate checks.
resource0 index of the building template passed to initBuilding.
resource1 index of the building template passed to initBuilding.
price0 paid in resource0 when building.
price1 paid in resource1 when building.
resourceIndex of the resourceFactor increased by the building.
resourceAmount added to the resourceFactor by the building.
X coordinate where the new building is placed.
Y coordinate where the new building is placed.
Index of the building template to construct.
Shop index (6-9) selecting which special item tier to claim.
Loop counter bound by resourceFactors[shopIndex] in claimSpecialResource.
Pseudo-random value (now-(item+shopIndex))%13 deciding the reward tier.
Computed resource index credited to the player for each awarded item.
Resource index being listed for sale on the marketplace.
Asking price recorded in marketplacePrices for the listed item.
Seller address whose listing is being purchased and who receives the payout.
Resource index being bought from the seller's listing.
X coordinate for the premium building placement.
Y coordinate for the premium building placement.
Premium building id (97, 98 or 99) determining the required payment.
msg.value/100 used to compute the owner, king, queen and seller payouts.

edges.reason: Constructor writes owner = msg.sender, setting privileged control over funds and building registration.
Constructor initializes the king address to msg.sender.
Constructor initializes kingSpirit to 0.
Constructor initializes the queen address to msg.sender.
Constructor initializes queenPrestige to 0.
Constructor initializes totalCities to 0.
Constructor initializes buildings_total to 0.
Constructor initializes sell_id to 0.
initBuilding writes a new Building template into buildings[buildings_total].
initBuilding increments buildings_total after appending a template.
initBuilding is guarded by the require(msg.sender == owner) access check.
logResources reads the caller's resources from the kingdoms mapping.
newLeader overwrites kingSpirit when the caller has a higher spirit factor.
newLeader sets the king address to the caller when spirit is higher.
newLeader overwrites queenPrestige when the caller has a higher prestige factor.
newLeader sets the queen address to the caller when prestige is higher.
initiateUser writes initial resources, map size and initiatet flag for the caller.
initiateUser increments totalCities when the player is initialized.
initiateUser calls logResources after initialization.
buildAt mutates the caller's map, resources, resourceFactors and populationNeeded.
buildAt performs unchecked resource subtraction and populationNeeded addition.
buildAt calls newLeader, letting any builder attempt to seize the king/queen throne.
buildAt calls logResources at the end of execution.
expandX forwards the received Ether via owner.transfer.
expandX increments the caller's mapX in the kingdoms mapping.
expandY forwards the received Ether via owner.transfer.
expandY increments the caller's mapY in the kingdoms mapping.
claimBasicResources adds resourceFactors values into the caller's balances without bounds checks.
claimBasicResources updates resources and lastClaimResources for the caller.
claimBasicResources gates claiming on now >= lastClaimResources + 1 hour (timestamp dependency).
claimBasicResources calls logResources after crediting resources.
claimSpecialResource computes rewards from a timestamp-derived modulo selector.
claimSpecialResource depends on block.timestamp both for the cooldown and for item selection.
claimSpecialResource credits item resources and updates lastClaimItems for the caller.
sellItem records the asking price in marketplacePrices[msg.sender][item].
sellItem records the listing id in marketplaceID[msg.sender][item].
sellItem increments sell_id after creating a listing.
sellItem reads the caller's resource balance to validate the listing.
buyItem reads and resets marketplacePrices[seller][item] during the purchase.
buyItem computes cut = msg.value/100 and splits the remainder among multiple recipients.
buyItem credits the purchased item to the buyer's resources.
buyItem calls logResources after the purchase completes.
buySpecialBuilding forwards the full msg.value to the owner.
buySpecialBuilding enforces the msg.value tier require together with the coordinate checks.
buySpecialBuilding writes the caller's map cell and resourceFactors bonuses.
buySpecialBuilding calls newLeader, allowing throne takeover by wealthy buyers.
msg.sender is compared to owner to authorize building template registration.
msg.sender selects which kingdom's resources are emitted by logResources.
msg.sender's resourceFactors determine king/queen promotion in newLeader.
msg.sender keys the kingdoms entry initialized by initiateUser.
msg.sender selects the building player's kingdom in buildAt.
msg.sender identifies the kingdom expanded by expandX.
msg.sender identifies the kingdom expanded by expandY.
msg.sender selects the kingdom credited by claimBasicResources.
msg.sender selects the kingdom credited by claimSpecialResource.
msg.sender is the marketplace listing owner in sellItem.
msg.sender is the buyer whose kingdom receives the item in buyItem.
msg.sender selects the buyer's kingdom and map in buySpecialBuilding.
block.timestamp feeds the cooldown check and the pseudo-random selector in claimSpecialResource.
block.timestamp is the sole entropy source of the reward selection, making it miner-influenceable.
expandX transfers Ether to the owner address.
expandY transfers Ether to the owner address.
buySpecialBuilding transfers Ether to the owner address.
Unchecked resource subtraction and factor addition mutate the caller's kingdoms entry.
buyItem sends the owner's 3x cut to the owner address.
buyItem sends a 1x cut to the current king address.
buyItem sends a 1x cut to the current queen address.
expandX performs an external Ether transfer to owner, which may invoke a fallback callback.
expandY performs an external Ether transfer to owner, which may invoke a fallback callback.
buySpecialBuilding performs an external Ether transfer to owner before emitting the build event.
buyItem makes four sequential external transfers (owner, king, queen, seller) before clearing the listing at the end.
initBuilding_r0 is stored into the Building template by initBuilding.
initBuilding_r1 is stored into the Building template by initBuilding.
initBuilding_p0 is stored into the Building template by initBuilding.
initBuilding_p1 is stored into the Building template by initBuilding.
initBuilding_m is stored as the resourceIndex of the Building template.
initBuilding_a is stored as the resourceAmount of the Building template.
buildAt_xpos indexes the caller's map cell being written.
buildAt_ypos indexes the caller's map cell being written.
buildAt_building indexes buildings[] and drives price/resource arithmetic in buildAt.
claimSpecialResource_shopIndex gates the claim range and selects the reward tier.
sellItem_item indexes the resource balance and marketplace mappings.
sellItem_price is written into marketplacePrices for the listing.
buyItem_seller selects the listing being bought and receives the remainder payout.
buyItem_item selects which resource is credited to the buyer.
buySpecialBuilding_xpos indexes the caller's map cell being written.
buySpecialBuilding_ypos indexes the caller's map cell being written.
buySpecialBuilding_building selects the payment tier and the spirit/prestige bonus applied.
buyItem_cut = msg.value/100 is the basis of all owner, king, queen and seller payouts.
